description: A funding source's area-to-volume figure is its summed area divided by its summed volume.

b.request: Per funding source: average [(boxy - boxx) / boxx] per record; average [aream2 / volm3] per record; sources where average ratio > simple mean of average ratios per source; output absolute difference above baseline
b.sql: WITH metrics_per_record AS (SELECT p.fundflux, (sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / NULLIF(sp.boxx, 0) AS ratio1, sp.aream2 / NULLIF(sp.volm3, 0) AS ratio2 FROM projects p JOIN scanspatial sp ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref), avg_per_source AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(ratio1) AS avg_ratio1, AVG(ratio2) AS avg_ratio2 FROM metrics_per_record WHERE ratio1 IS NOT NULL AND ratio2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fundflux), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio1) AS mean_avg_ratio1 FROM avg_per_source) SELECT aps.fundflux, aps.avg_ratio1, aps.avg_ratio2, ABS(aps.avg_ratio1 - b.mean_avg_ratio1) AS diff_above_baseline FROM avg_per_source aps CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE aps.avg_ratio1 > b.mean_avg_ratio1 ORDER BY diff_above_baseline DESC

---

Per funding source: calculate average of [(boxy - boxx) / boxx] per record; calculate area-to-volume ratio as sum(aream2) / sum(volm3); identify sources where ratio exceeds simple mean of all per-source ratios; show funding source, average Y-vs-X difference, ratio, and absolute difference above mean, without rounding

a.request: For each funding source (`projects.fundflux`), using the spatial records (`scanspatial`) whose `arcref` matches a project's `arcregistry` and dropping any that don't match, work out two numbers. The first is the average over the records of (`boxy` − `boxx`) ÷ `boxx`. The second is the area-to-volume ratio, taken as the records' total `aream2` divided by their total `volm3`. Ignore missing values. Then take the simple average of that area-to-volume figure across all funding sources. List only the funding sources whose figure is above that average. Show the funding source, the average Y-vs-X difference, the area-to-volume figure, and how far the figure is above the cross-source average, with no rounding.
a.sql:
WITH spatial_with_funding AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    ss.boxx,
    ss.boxy,
    ss.aream2,
    ss.volm3
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(CASE WHEN boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxy IS NOT NULL AND boxx != 0 
             THEN (boxy - boxx) / boxx END) as avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    SUM(CASE WHEN aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN aream2 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN volm3 ELSE 0 END), 0) as area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM spatial_with_funding
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
valid_metrics AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM funding_metrics
  WHERE area_to_volume_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
cross_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM valid_metrics
)
SELECT 
  vm.fundflux,
  vm.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  vm.area_to_volume_ratio,
  vm.area_to_volume_ratio - ca.avg_ratio as above_average
FROM valid_metrics vm
CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca
WHERE vm.area_to_volume_ratio > ca.avg_ratio
ORDER BY vm.fundflux

d.request: For each funding source, compute the average relative difference between boxy and boxx as (boxy − boxx) ÷ boxx per record, and the area-to-volume ratio as the sum of all aream2 divided by the sum of all volm3 for that funding source; identify funding sources whose area-to-volume ratio exceeds the simple average of all funding sources' ratios; display the funding source, average Y-vs-X difference, area-to-volume ratio, and the excess above the average, with no rounding.
d.sql: WITH spatial_with_funding AS (SELECT p.fundflux, s.boxx, s.boxy, s.aream2, s.volm3, (s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx AS yvsxdiff FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry), funding_stats AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(yvsxdiff) AS avg_yvsxdiff, SUM(aream2) / SUM(volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM spatial_with_funding GROUP BY fundflux), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM funding_stats) SELECT fs.fundflux, fs.avg_yvsxdiff, fs.area_to_volume_ratio, fs.area_to_volume_ratio - oa.overall_avg_ratio AS excess FROM funding_stats fs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE fs.area_to_volume_ratio > oa.overall_avg_ratio ORDER BY fs.fundflux

c.request: Using the spatial records (`scanspatial`) whose `arcref` matches a project's `arcregistry` and dropping any that don't match, look at each funding source (`projects.fundflux`). For each one, give the average relative difference between `boxy` and `boxx`, computed per record as (`boxy` − `boxx`) ÷ `boxx`, and give its area-to-volume ratio (`aream2` to `volm3`). Ignore missing values. Which funding sources have a ratio above the simple average of that ratio across all funding sources? Show the funding source, the average Y-vs-X difference, the ratio, and how far the ratio is above that average, with no rounding. A funding source's area-to-volume figure is its summed area divided by its summed volume.
c.sql:
WITH spatial_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.aream2,
    ss.volm3,
    ss.boxx,
    ss.boxy,
    p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial ss
  INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE ss.boxx IS NOT NULL 
    AND ss.boxy IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.aream2 IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.volm3 IS NOT NULL
    AND p.fundflux IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.boxx != 0
),
funding_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG((boxy - boxx) / boxx) as avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    SUM(aream2) / SUM(volm3) as area_vol_ratio
  FROM spatial_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_vol_ratio) as overall_ratio
  FROM funding_stats
)
SELECT 
  fs.fundflux,
  fs.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  fs.area_vol_ratio,
  fs.area_vol_ratio - oa.overall_ratio as above_average
FROM funding_stats fs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE fs.area_vol_ratio > oa.overall_ratio
ORDER BY fs.area_vol_ratio DESC
